name: caption_ink
description: Make captions readable over light full-screen cards. Renders the frame without captions at each caption, measures the backdrop in the rows the caption draws in, and writes ink ("dark" over a light card, "light" over a dark one) and inkAuto (the card's id) on the caption, so the editor, sample_frame and the export draw the same. Footage is left to the style. An ink a person set is never changed; ink this step wrote is cleared when the card is gone. Does nothing for plate and subtitle. generate_captions runs it when the project has a card. Writes the captions only; a caption edit since it read them is refused.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {dark, light, cleared, kept, warnings?}: captions set dark, set light, cleared, and left as a person set them.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json
